from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# Impute missing values in GNI per capita dataset
imputer_gni = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
gni_per_capita_imputed = imputer_gni.fit_transform(gni_per_capita)

# Impute missing values in economic output dataset
imputer_economic_output = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
economic_output_imputed = imputer_economic_output.fit_transform(economic_output)

# Prepare the data for regression with imputed values
X = np.hstack((education_expenditure, gni_per_capita_imputed))
y = economic_output_imputed

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients
